stem: Which statement describes one way trees are dependent on nonliving parts of the environment?

options.label: A
options.text: Many birds build nests in trees.

options.label: B
options.text: Different organisms rely on trees to provide food.

options.label: C
options.text: Some trees need fire to release their seeds.

options.label: D
options.text: Trees provide shade for plants that grow near them.
